title: Granular approval paths and explainer cards for workspace RBAC & audit
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: Workspace admins struggle to understand why access was granted and which approval path was used. The current audit log is dense and requires cross-referencing several pages. Goal: design compact, scannable 'explainer cards' that surface the approval path, decision rationale, and cost implications (if an on-call or reserved action triggered autoscaling) directly in the audit and RBAC flows. Approach: prototype two card variants (summary + expanded timeline) and an inline approval-path visualizer that can be embedded in 'Who can' and role-detail screens. Deliverables: Figma prototype, annotated Confluence spec, engineering handoff, and moderated usability test with 6 internal admins.
acceptance_criteria: Explainer card surfaces: actor, timestamp, approval path (roles/groups/approvals), and one-sentence rationale
Expanded timeline shows ordered steps with links to the approving user's session and related PR/incident if available
Cards render inside audit log list without causing >10% increase in render time on typical account (performance validation with ENG)
Design has accessible color contrast and screen-reader labels for each card element
Designs include a compact collapsed state and full state; both reviewed by PM and Security
Prototype validated with at least 6 admins; >70% find path visualization 'clear' or 'very clear'
decisions: Use a two-tier card pattern (summary row + expandable timeline) to balance density and discoverability
Show approval path as a compact breadcrumb with avatars and role labels; expand to timeline with metadata (IP, session ID) only when security_review_required is true
Inline cost indicator added when action triggers Dedicated pool changes or autoscaling; shown as subtle chip linking to cost breakdown
Keep primary interaction keyboard-first; expand/collapse mapped to Enter/Space and explicit chevron button for mouse users
engineering_notes: Front-end: recommended implementation as virtualized list items with lazy hydration of expanded timeline to reduce initial render work
Back-end: audit API will need a lightweight aggregated 'approval_path' field to avoid N+1 calls; ENG-9812 owns schema change
Performance target: expanded timeline fetch should be under 250ms p50 in EU and US regions; ENG to provide mock endpoints for prototype testing
Security: PII (session IP) must be redacted for non-admins; tie visibility to role-check middleware (see ENG-10244)
Accessibility: use role="article" and aria-expanded states; provide alt text for avatar fallbacks
